findings.title: Trace is near the state-heavy review threshold
findings.description: The baseline profile flags storage and account access as a medium review prompt.
findings.recommendation: Replay representative transactions under the default threshold profile.

findings.title: Trace omits some useful compatibility evidence
findings.description: The trace was usable, but some formats omit calldata byte counts or per-op gas costs.
findings.recommendation: Prefer traces with calldata sizes and gas costs when available.

findings.title: Trace includes calldata-heavy execution
findings.description: The default profile records calldata exposure as an informational prompt.
findings.recommendation: Keep calldata-heavy calls in replay fixtures.

findings.title: Trace executes contract creation
findings.description: The trace includes CREATE or CREATE2 execution.
findings.recommendation: Replay deployment paths against fork configurations when available.

assumptions: Baseline report uses the default threshold profile.
limitations: The report contains compatibility prompts, not gas estimates.
